title: [IMP-27] RFC 9421 profile and manifest signer are under-specified
description: Review finding IMP-27: RFC 9421 profile and manifest signer are under-specified (lens IMP). Location: spec/10-relays.md:102, :116, :167-183; spec/11-transport.md:214-219. Fix: As proposed. The signer conflict is confirmed: 10:102 says "by the Relay operator's key", while 10:116 says "signed by the key declared in the DID document" of `relayDID`. Apply the same profile to the push wake-up (11:214-219). Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/10-relays.md §10.2.1 manifest signed per §13.1.1 by relayDID with key in both keys and DID document (signer conflict gone); §10.2.3 Profile (sig1, keyid DID URL, alg ed25519, created, nonce, covered components incl. content-digest, replay rules); spec/11-transport.md §11.7.4/§11.7.5 push wake-u
